title: Add a task and set its priority
style: Read this in a calm, friendly and unhurried voice, as if showing a colleague

lines.text: This is Tidy, a small task list. Here is how to add a task, and say how urgent it is.
lines._spoken: This is Tidy, a small task list. Here is how to add a task, and say how urgent it is.

lines.text: Type what needs doing in the box at the top.

lines.text: Choose its priority from the menu beside it. This one is High.

lines.text: Then click Add task. It joins the list, with its priority on the right.
